# Third-party resources and licences

- ROBOTIS TurtleBot3 MuJoCo XML/STL assets are fetched at the commit in `resources.lock.json`. The project derives its scenes in memory and retains the original Apache-2.0 licence in `robotis/LICENSE`.
- OpenCV ArUco, corner refinement, PnP and reprojection use the pinned PyPI distribution. `opencv/LICENSE.txt` and `opencv/LICENSE-3RD-PARTY.txt` are the original notices copied from that installed distribution.
- NumPy, MuJoCo, Matplotlib, Pillow and other pinned dependencies are installed from their distributions with their applicable notices. Their environments and binaries are not bundled here.
- The course UR3 tutorial provided environment/model-loading/viewer reference. Its arm controller is not used as a wheel controller and its source is not redistributed here.

The [project entry](../README.md#third-party-sources) links to the report containing the source references and OpenAI Codex declaration. I have not assigned a new open-source licence to my own project material.
